name: v27-d-05-briefing
objective: v2.7 05 live (D) row, no model, scripted messages only. With display.briefing on (the runner switches it off for every run and restores it): importing a briefed story into a group chat opens dialog#so-briefing once; after Set out it stays closed across a reload, a swipe and an edit of the reply (once per chat, extras.briefing.seen); Restart shows it again; /story intro and the drawer's Story briefing button (#so-story-briefing) re-open it; with display.briefing off a Restart does not show it. The C8 'how it works' section marks help.onboardingSeen, which cleanup puts back. Not here: Before you start in the modal (covered by v27-d-04 inline and the BriefingModal stories) and the opener payload capture (briefingActivation.test.ts payload invariance). Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-05-briefing.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: scripted messages only (/sendas); a model would only add reads the briefing does not depend on

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so the message ids below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const help = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.settings?.help ?? {}; sessionStorage.setItem('v27d05', JSON.stringify({ onboardingSeen: help.onboardingSeen ?? null })); rt.setUiSettings({ briefing: true }); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().display.briefing !== true) throw new Error('display.briefing did not switch on'); return { briefing: true, onboardingSeenBefore: help.onboardingSeen ?? null };

import_story.title: SO-V27D05 Briefing
import_story.description: v2.7 05 live row: a story with an authored briefing.

sections.heading: Where you are
sections.text: A wet road at the edge of town, and a friend who will not wait long.

sections.heading: What you want
sections.text: Reach the coast before the autumn storms close the pass.

steps.eval: const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const dialog = await until(() => { const node = document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing'); return node?.open ? node : null; }, 10000, "the briefing to open on the story's first activation in this chat"); const title = dialog.querySelector('#so-briefing-title')?.textContent?.trim() ?? null; if (title !== 'The Long Road') throw new Error(`the briefing shows another title: ${title}`); return { open: true, title };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing')?.open) throw new Error('Set out did not close the briefing'); if (rt.getSnapshot().briefing?.pending) throw new Error('the briefing is still pending after it was closed'); return { pending: rt.getSnapshot().briefing?.pending ?? null };

steps.send: I shoulder my pack and look down the road.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The road waits, and so do I.

steps.eval: const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await sleep(3000); if (document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing')?.open) throw new Error("reopening the chat showed the briefing again"); return { open: false };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const reply = ctx.chat[ctx.chat.length - 1]; if (!reply || reply.is_user) throw new Error('the newest message is not the reply'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'The road is long, and I am already wet.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipes: 2 };

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await sleep(2000); if (document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing')?.open) throw new Error("a swipe showed the briefing again"); return { open: false };

edit.text: The road is long, and the rain has not stopped.

'null'); if (!saved) return { restored: false }; const help = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.settings?.help; if (help) { if (saved.onboardingSeen === null) delete help.onboardingSeen; else help.onboardingSeen = saved.onboardingSeen; } ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); sessionStorage.removeItem('v27d05'); return { restored: true, onboardingSeen: saved.onboardingSeen };
